scientific_integrity: Proof of an all-length explicit fiber and an exhaustive exact finite maximum at five worlds; independent bounded replication. Previously published general four-profile and fiber-product theorems are credited.
scientific_limitations: Fixed labelled finite intuitionistic chains with arbitrary accessibility, four specified modal operations and all upset valuations. Five-world maximum exact; for n≥6 only an improved general lower bound, no all-size maximum theorem.
title: Improved lower bounds and a sharp five-world maximum for four-modal observational fibers
